identity.name: Indian Creek
identity.notes: Indian Creek is an ultra-luxury, gated waterfront enclave on Biscayne Bay in northeastern Miami-Dade County. It comprises roughly 3,200-3,300 private waterfront homes on about 4,000+ acres. The community's only land access is a single drawbridge, which is controlled and monitored, giving it a reputation as one of the most private and exclusive communities in the United States, home to many celebrities, business leaders, and international residents.

fees.note: HOA dues are substantial due to gate/drawbridge operation, security, and bayfront maintenance. Reported in the range of roughly $600-$1,500+/month depending on parcel size and location; no verified current schedule available. Residents also pay separate water/sewer (septic is common) and utility costs. No CDD assessment is generally associated with properties here, as community infrastructure is funded through association dues and historic capital contributions.

amenities.detail: Single controlled drawbridge is the only road access into the community; access is restricted to residents, their guests, and service vehicles, with security monitoring at the bridge.
Indian Creek Yacht Club is a historic, private social club within the community, one of its most famous features.
Community boat basin/marina facilities for residents; nearly every home is waterfront on Biscayne Bay with private dock access.
Indian Creek Golf & Yacht Club golf course located within the community.
Tennis courts maintained within the community.
Pickleball/paddle courts available in the community (popular with the active retiree demographic).
Approximately 3,200+ private waterfront homes, all with direct Biscayne Bay frontage; community is a premier boating and fishing destination.

demographics.geography_level: census-designated place (Indian Creek CDP), Miami-Dade County, FL; approximate Census/ACS figures for the community area only, not the surrounding unincorporated county land (Bayfront/Biscayne Park area is much larger and includes non-resident bayfront lots). Population estimate ~4,300 (2020 Census), median household income estimated ~$500,000 (among the highest in the U.S.), median age ~55 (skews older due to retiree/second-home owner base), owner-occupancy ~85%.

proximity.nearest_name: North Bay Shopping Center (North Miami); Aventura Mall further out
Miami-Dade Public Library - North Miami branch (nearest M-DPL branch; Hollywood branch in Broward County is similar distance)
Biscayne Park / downtown Miami via Bayfront Drive or I-95; ~15-25 min drive
